name: HTTP Proxy Codespaces
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tinyproxy && sudo sed -i 's/^Port .*/Port 1080/' /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf && sudo sed -i '/^Allow /d' /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf && echo 'Allow 0.0.0.0/0' | sudo tee -a /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf
